text:
Which combination of the current in a resistor and the time for which it is present results in a
charge of 240C passing through the resistor?
A
a current of 2.0A for 120s
B
a current of 4.0A for 960s
C
a current of 6.0A for 40 minutes
D
a current of 8.0A for 30 minutes
subject: Physics
